light_levels.setting.style.tooltip: Cross: an X on the block. Square: a see-through square. Number: the spot's block light level.
light_levels.setting.radius.tooltip: How far around you blocks are marked, in blocks across the ground.
light_levels.setting.height.tooltip: How far above and below your feet blocks are marked, in blocks.
light_levels.setting.limit.tooltip: The most block light a spot can have and still be marked. 0 is today's rule in the Overworld and the End; 7 for the Nether or older servers.
light_levels.setting.split_sky.tooltip: On: red where mobs can spawn by day too (sky light below 8), yellow where they spawn only at night. Off: every mark is red.
light_levels.setting.red.tooltip: The colour of spots where mobs can spawn day and night.
light_levels.setting.yellow.tooltip: The colour of spots where mobs spawn only at night.
light_levels.setting.width.tooltip: How thick the crosses and numbers are, in pixels on the screen.
light_levels.setting.remember.tooltip: Off: the marks start hidden in every world you join. On: if you left them shown, they show again in the next world you join, until you quit the game.
